_doc: Tier-Letter score cutoffs for /tft/units, /tft/items, /tft/comps. The helper in app/lib/tft-tier-letter.ts reads the default block if no set-specific block is present; perSet[<set>].scoreCutoffsByKind overrides per entity kind. Re-calibrate after each set drop: the target split is ~10/15/25/30/20 % across S/A/B/C/D. Set 18 calibrated 2026-08-27 on euw1+na1+kr over 7 days (195 units / 330 items / 57 comps above the sample gate) - one global block cannot hit the target for all three kinds, items cluster far tighter than units. minGames keeps low-sample noise out of the badge; null is shown instead.
